title: FTP deploys never touch user uploads
summary: The FTP sync now excludes the whole public/storage subtree, skips symlinks, and enforces the exclusion even if config is edited.
body:
All user content — comic pages and covers, avatars, post media — lives under public/storage/, where local and remote legitimately differ. An early version of the deploy excludes only matched the literal path, so same-named local files could have overwritten host uploads.

The whole subtree is now excluded, symlinked directories are never traversed, and a hardcoded safety list in the deployer survives even a wiped config. Verified against the real project tree: 21 user files, 0 uploadable.
